mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1100 thousand units in the prior two months signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to generate positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 235.0 in high inflation regimes signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to generate positive returns in more than 55% of instances over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annualized in the prior four months signals robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through accelerated revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to generate positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises in a regime of UNRATE < 4.0%.
